Subject: RE: Norvell Roofing Submission

Hi Tomas,

Thanks for thinking of us for this submission. Unfortunately, we'll need to pass on Norvell Roofing as roofing contractors fall outside our current appetite.

Given the class of business, I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty contractor market, one that actively writes roofing risks and should be able to provide competitive terms.

I appreciate you sending this our way, and please keep us in mind for risks that fit our sweet spot (light manufacturing, wholesale distribution, and office operations).

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
